dict.string: NetWatch finds and monitors the devices on your home network.
NetWatch lists nearby Bluetooth devices and warns you about unknown item trackers. It only listens and never connects to other devices.
NetWatch uses your location only to show nearby Wi-Fi network names and to warn you if an unknown tracker travels with you. It never leaves this Mac.
